name: Venexus AP OLD

items.name: Primordial Flame
items.description:
Created by the Kellid goddess Sister Cinder to lead her believers out of the Age of Darkness, this hand-held lamp is constructed from animal bone, hide, and sinew, and it contains an eternal flame that requires neither fuel nor oxygen to burn. The lamp's flame can be covered or hidden, but it can't be smothered or quenched. While uncovered, the Primordial Flame sheds bright light in a 100-foot radius (and dim light for the next 100 feet). If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, the Primordial Flame attempts to counteract the darkness with a counteract rank of 10 and a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+35 #Counteract]]{+35}.

The presence of the Primordial Flame alters the surrounding environment, changing weather patterns, temperature, climate, and even seasons. Within a 10-mile radius of the Primordial Flame, the temperature remains 70° F (21° C) during the day and 60° F (16° C) at night. The weather is calm and free from extreme weather conditions (such as blizzards, hail, thunderstorms, and tornadoes), and the sky remains clear. Plants in the area flourish as if they were receiving optimal sunlight, water, and nutrients for their species, despite the lack of precipitation. If the Primordial Flame remains in the same region for an extended time, the area of this effect increases (typically by 1 mile each year, though terrain and other factors might alter this limit). During the time Venexus carried the Primordial Flame, its environmental reach expanded to cover the entirety of Lost Mammoth Valley.

Cursed The Primordial Flame was cursed by Syarstik Painted-Tiger, the guardian spirit of Red Cat Cave. As long as it remains cursed, a creature that holds the Primordial Flame can't willingly give up possession. A creature that has held the Primordial Flame and no longer has it in their possession is wracked with mental anguish, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 4}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 4}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fatigued]; these conditions can't be reduced or removed until the creature regains possession of the Primordial Flame or the curse is removed. The curse can be removed only by avenging Syarstik.

Activate 3 command, Interact

Frequency once per week

Effect The Primordial Flame's light intensifies, shedding bright sunlight in a 10-mile radius (and dim light to the next mile) for 1 hour. If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, the Primordial Flame attempts to counteract the darkness with a counteract rank of 10 and a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+35 #Counteract]]{+35}.

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect The Primordial Flame casts a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sunburst] spell. If you can cast spells higher than 7th level, the Primordial Flame automatically heightens sunburst to half your level rounded up.

Activate 2 command, Interact

Effect The Primordial Flame casts a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ignition] spell. If you can cast spells higher than 5th level, the Primordial Flame automatically heightens produce flame to half your level rounded up.

Destruction If used to slay a herald of Sister Cinder while on the Shadow Plane, the Primordial Flame is destroyed.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Freezing Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature deals piercing or slashing damage to Venexus

Effect Venexus's blood splatters onto the triggering creature, dealing 2d6 Cold Damage damage. A creature that takes cold damage in this way is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 25 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mist Shroud
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. The Primordial Flame continually heats the cold emanating from Venexus's body, surrounding the dragon in a thin veil of fog. Creatures in the aura are Concealed, and other creatures are concealed to creatures in the area. Venexus's storm vision allows her to see through this concealment, however. If wind disperses the aura, it returns automatically at the start of Venexus's turn. The aura is suppressed in water.

defensiveAbilities.name: Storm Vision
defensiveAbilities.description: Inclement weather doesn't impair Venexus's vision; she ignores concealment from fog, mist, rain, and snowfall.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: Venexus breathes a cloud of frost that deals 10d6 Cold Damage damage in a 40ft Cone (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw). She can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: Venexus makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: When Venexus scores a critical hit with a Strike, she recharges her Breath Weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Climb 30 feet
offensiveAbilities.description: Venexus can climb on ice as though she had the listed climb Speed. She ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shape Ice
offensiveAbilities.description: Venexus magically reshapes a cube of ice or snow she touches, up to 10 feet across. Any creature standing atop the ice must succeed at a DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save or Acrobatics check. On a failure, the creature falls Prone on the ice; on a critical failure, it falls off the ice entirely and is also prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Snuff
offensiveAbilities.description: Venexus releases a wave of sleet, which douses open flames within 30 feet. All non-magical fire is automatically extinguished. All creatures in the area suffering from persistent fire damage immediately attempt a DC 10 Flat to end the persistent damage. If Snuff overlaps with an ongoing fire effect, Snuff attempts to counteract the fire effect.

cantrips.name: Produce Flame
cantrips.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and (@item.level)d4 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

lv1spells.name: Gust of Wind (At Will)
lv1spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
lv1spells.description:
A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked Prone. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked Prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

lv2spells.name: Obscuring Mist (At Will)
lv2spells.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

lv7spells.name: Sunburst
lv7spells.description:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus 8d10 additional vitality damage to undead creatures. Each creature and object in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Critical Success The creature or object is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage. If it's a creature, it becomes Blinded permanently.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.
